title: Apply for a patent
summary: Learn how to apply for a patent to protect your invention, whether it is a device, substance, method, or process, in Australia.
intro:
If you've developed a new device, substance, method, or process, you can apply for a patent to give you rights over your invention in Australia.

You must be able to prove you're the actual inventor, or that you have entitlement from the actual inventor(s).

You can use a patent to protect devices, substances, methods or processes.

who_can_apply: You must be able to prove you are the actual inventor, or that you have entitlement from the actual inventor(s).
what_you_need: The invention must be a device, substance, method, or process.
